profile.headline: Build Systems and Developer Productivity at Rivian
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer with a love for continual learning, growth, and relationship building. Experienced in Go, and Kubernetes for platform and DevOps/infrastructure engineering. Cultivating a newfound love of Bazel and all things build and release engineering. 

I love being handed a gnarly problem and delivering results that require collaboration and a high degree of figuring-shit-out.

Leadership:
- Experience leading software engineers and technical initiatives
- Establishing a strong sense of team values and purpose
- Cultivating a strong sense of hospitality towards customers and fellow engineers

Software Engineering:
- Development of containerized services for cloud-native applications
- gRPC and REST based inter-service communication
- Crafting effective solutions in simple, expressive code

DevOps:
- Deep Kubernetes experience including the creation of controllers for CRDs
- Helm chart and Kustomization development for Kubernetes resources and Argo CD Applications
- CI/CD in Argo CD, FluxCD, Argo Workflows, and Github actions

Cloud Technologies:
- Google Cloud:
  - BigQuery
  - PubSub
  - GKE
  - IAM & security management
  - Vertex AI Workbench Notebooks
  - Compute Engine

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Build systems and developer productivity at Rivian Automotive

positions.title: Software Engineer IV (Lead)
positions.description:
Lead Software engineer working on the Edge Retail project as a build, release, and platform engineer. Tech Lead of the Foundation squad responsible for CI/CD, infrastructure, DevOps, Go services and tools, and any other interesting challenges that come our way. Created a strong sense of team values and purpose serving our fellow engineers as our customers and being good stewards of the monorepo build and CI resources. Chair of the Build/Release working group focused on improving the developer experience and velocity of building and shipping software for the 60+ engineers on the Edge project.

Subject matter lead for the Bazel build system crafting hermetic and reproducible build artifacts for Kubernetes deployment (rules_go, rules_oci, rules_apko, rules_distroless).

Notable projects:
- Reduced the resource usage of a critical Kubernetes controller by 60% by profiling with pprof and replacing external packages with simpler internal implementations
- Created a release management Go CLI tool to bundle kustomize-built manifests into an OCI index. Migrated to a config-driven approach that simplified and clarified the state of releases in target environments
- Wrote multiple Bazel Gazelle language extensions to create build files for custom Bazel rules

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer on the Foundation team developing tooling for the Bazel build system and Kubernetes controllers.

Developed deep skills and knowledge on a wide variety of tools and concepts in a short time period including but not limited to:
- The Bazel build ecosystem and concepts
- Kubernetes internals and owning the development and evolution of a critical infrastructure deployment controller
- The OCI (open container initiative) format and using it in conjunction with a Kubernetes controller to apply infrastructure and runtime resources to clusters

Notable Projects:
- Created a package lock and versioning system ensuring all released OCI artifacts were promoted to downstream environments in a consistent and reproducible process
- Wrote a Bazel rule for building Kustomizations bringing the built Kustomizations into the build graph and allowing for their consumption for downstream rules
- Created an apk repository proxy backed by GCP cloud storage buckets to privately serve custom-built Alpine Linux apk packages

positions.title: Senior Platform Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Databases · Go (Programming Language) · Kubernetes · Microservices · Docker Products

positions.title: Software Engineer, Data
positions.description:
Software engineer and tech lead of the data engineering team at Caribou. 

Helping create the next generation data platform at Caribou through event driven data ingestion, platform engineering, and infrastructure architecture. 

Currently exploring a newfound love of DevOps and infrastructure management.

Project highlights include:

- Migrated Caribou's Airflow environment from Google Cloud Composer managed instances to self-hosted environments in Kubernetes via helm charts and Argo CD Applications
- Creation of an event streaming service to capture Postgres CDC and stream into BigQuery to replace a large SaaS tool
- Established an extensible pattern for securely sharing and syncing of data in Cloud Storage Buckets across GCP projects via Kubernetes
- Led the communication and adoption of DevOps culture into the Data Engineering team by transferring knowledge of Kubernetes, helm charts, GCP infrastructure, and Backstage templating/usage
positions.insights: Skills: Databases · Go (Programming Language) · Kubernetes · Microservices · Docker Products

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description:
Data Engineer creating new and improving existing data pipelines using Python, SQL, Airflow. Performs a variety of ETL/ELT tasks on a diverse set of data sources. Interacts with business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions.

Builds internal tools and frameworks in Python for reusable, scalable operations. 

Current tools include:
Airflow
Vertica DB 
NoSQL: AWS S3, Azure Cosmos DB, Mongo DB

positions.title: Informatics Data Engineer
positions.description:
Member of the Emory University Data Solutions team embedded in the department of Anesthesiology. 

Performs data extractions from Emory's Clinical Data Warehouse using a combination of SQL, PL/SQL and Python. Lead technical analyst involved in the requirements gathering, business metric
development, and technical solutions for projects ranging from quality improvement
initiatives to IRB approved research studies.

Notable projects: 
* Created pipeline for extracting, evaluating, and storing metrics for diabetes treatment during surgery
* Developed a Microsoft Graph API Python SDK for internal use 
* Provided data sets for 40+ IRB approved research studies including OR opioid reduction and COVID-19 blood coagulation risks
* Developed quality improvement metric notifications sent to providers on a monthly basis
* Report and ETL automation for team members

positions.title: PeopleSoft Software Engineer
positions.description:
Member of Emory University's HRIS technical team developing custom solutions for PeopleSoft systems. Created front and back end solutions provided by business analysts. 

Notable projects: 
* Developed integration between PeopleSoft and iCIMS recruiting software by created a RESTful integration endpoint within PeopleSoft

positions.title: PeopleSoft Business Analyst
positions.description:
Member of the PeopleSoft Business Analyst team at Emory University HR Technology. Primary Administrator for Emory's Enterprise Learning Management system. Institutes enhancements, break fixes, and end-user requests for changes to PeopleSoft HRMS and ELM systems.

Graduate of Emory's Business Practice Improvement scholar's program class of September 2014.
-Year-long practicum/project focusing on analyzing and improving Emory's faculty and staff onboarding practices

-Weekly courses/lectures centered around process improvement topics including:
  +Project management
  +Business psychology
  +Change management
  +Basic finance
  +Data collection and analysis

-Lectures from key leaders and stakeholders across Emory's academic and business departments
  +Executive VP of Business and Administration
  +Executive VP of HR
  +CIO of Emory University
  +Chief Investment Officer for the University

positions.title: Digital Archivist - Cost Accounting Summer Intern
positions.description:
-Independently led a digitization of 20 years of paper records
-Tasks included sorting hard copies of documents and entering them into a Microsoft Access Database
 -Also worked in inventory management and Access database cleanup

positions.title: Resident Advisor
positions.description:
-Professionally trained in maintaining the well-being of college aged students 
-Organized and led programs for both the floor and the entire building, including trips around the greater Columbus area, a formal dance, and an all day movie marathon
-Also trained in QPR suicide prevention techniques as well as conflict mediation and dispute resolution
